proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9502 *bhiyajyate gets wet explicitly gives Assamese bhiziba, Bengali bhijā, Oriya bhijibā, Maithili bhijlāh wet and Bhojpuri bhījal. The survey bij/bhij/bhiz series and l-participial forms match those comparanda. Affricate/retroflex-affricate notation, aspiration, final vowels and local transmission remain qualified; no extra light verb is silently discarded. Exact response: bhiḍž.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9503 *bhiyañjati wets/is wetted explicitly gives Bhojpuri bhī̃jal and Gujarati bhĩjāvũ/bhĩjavvũ. Nasal binj/bhinj wet responses match this nasal branch, with aspiration loss, y/ai and l-participial endings qualified. They are not collapsed into the nonnasal 9502 stem; the local transmission route remains open. Exact response: bhiṇḍž.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9500 *bhiyagna wet explicitly gives Oriya bhigā and the bhig- verb family, distinguishing the g-bearing stem from *bhiyajyate 9502. The simple bhig/big wet responses preserve that stem, with regional l-participial endings, aspiration and inflection qualified. No underlying nasal is supplied where the survey has none; the precise local transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: bhiga.
